notes.title: Patch 1.4.5 - It's A Trap!
notes.content: Patch 1.4.5 is a very exciting patch. 6 new unlockable cards, 1 new spawnable card, and a ton of balance and quality of life updates. Let's break it down![h1]Patch 1.4.5[/h1][list] 	[*][h1]New Cards[/h1][list] 	[*][b]Cry Baby[/b] - When Cry Baby takes damage, it spawns two 1/1 Anti-Ship Weapons Platform that last for two turns.[/*] 	[*][b]Mysterious Pact[/b] - Upon entering play, discard your hand and take X damage, where X is equal to the total amount of cards discared. X cards from your deck, with a mana cost of X or less, will come into play.[/*] 	[*][b]Radioactive Trace Compression Block[/b] - Decrease your ship's health by 1 per turn. You gain +2 energy per turn.[/*] 	[*][b]Poisoning The Well[/b] - When this card enters play, after 2 turns, it will deal 2 damage to all of your opponent's boarding party.[/*] 	[*][b]Nime the Friendly[/b] - When Nime the Friendly comes into play, he buffs the health of all current cards on the board.(This buff does not stack with other buff effects.)[/*] 	[*][b]Multiphasic Blaster[/b] - At the end of Multiphasic Blaster's turn, the residual radiation left behind will deal 1 damage to the enemy.[/*][/list][/*] 	[*][h1]Card Changes[/h1][list] 	[*][b]Marine[/b] art changed.[/*] 	[*]Added Art to the [b]Grappler[/b] and [b]Commander Geod[/b][/*] 	[*][b]J-54 Defender[/b] - Health changed from 3 to 2[/*] 	[*][b]Encrypted Sentrybot[/b] - Health changed from 5 to 3. Energy cost requirement changed from 3 to 4.[/*] 	[*][b]Mk.5 Autoturret[/b] - Energy cost requirement changed from 5 to 6.[/*] 	[*][b]Temporal Field[/b] - Energy cost requirement changed from 5 to 3.[/*] 	[*][b]Space Grave[/b] - Energy cost requirement changed from 4 to 3.[/*] 	[*]Trap notifications added to trap cards when they are triggered.[/*][/list][/*] 	[*][h1]New Features[/h1][list] 	[*][b]Coupon System[/b] - Under the profile tab, you can enter code's to redeem for in-game currency(Energy). These codes will be given away as part of promotions.[/*] 	[*][b]Tournament Play[/b] - This is a secret mode that can be accessed when given the code by a developer. This code will allow you to join sanctioned tournament servers.[/*][/list][/*] 	[*][h1]UI Updates[/h1][list] 	[*]Options added to the setting menu(Audio, Resolution, Fullscreen/Windowed)[/*][/list][/*][/list]To celebrate this patch, and the addition of the Coupon system, you can use the Coupon Code [u][b]"spooky" [/b][/u]in the Coupon system on your profile to obtain 333 credits. Hurry though, it expires on November 1st!

notes.title: Patch 1.4.4 - Welcome to Captivus
notes.content: The day has finally arrived. I've been in crunch mode all night, preparing to release Captivus. I can proudly announce, that it is ready. It passed most of my testing checks, and while I expect a larger audience to find more bugs, I am confident that I can hopefully have them fixed by the end of the day. So, without further ado, welcome to Patch 1.4.4, the first patch of Early Access.[h1]Patch 1.4.4[/h1][list] 	[*][h1]Card Updates[/h1][list] 	[*]All Units and Defenders updated to only allow a max of four in deck.(Old amount was six.)[/*] 	[*][b]Streamlined[/b] Hull energy cost changed from 3 to 6.[/*] 	[*][b]Space Grave[/b] max deck allowance changed from 4 to 3.[/*][/list][/*] 	[*][h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][list] 	[*][b]Tactical Nuke[/b] now properly removes all cards from the board.[/*] 	[*]In-game UI now properly displays your Ranked Border, Ranked Icon, and Title.[/*][/list][/*] 	[*][h1]Backend Changes[/h1][list] 	[*]When unlocking a duplicate card through the Deck Builder, you will now activate a Dupe Counter. The dupe counter increases the amount of energy you recieve by 5 for each duplicate, with a max of 90 energy returned. This should make the unlock process feel less grindy as you are losing less energy.[/*] 	[*]DLC Edition: Founder rewards will now properly be given to those who purchase the DLC. This may take several minutes toupdate on your profile.[/*] 	[*]AI Difficulty decreased.[/*][/list][/*] 	[*][h1]UI Updates[/h1][list] 	[*]Deck Builder now shows the min. amount needed to play a game.(20 cards)[/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.4.3c - Instant Cards
notes.content: Greetings,If you like card games, and you've played Magic: The Gathering, then you are most definitely familiar with the concept of the Instant card. These cards can be played at any point in the game, whether it's your opponent's turn or not. I've always been a fan of this, and personally believe hearthstone could benefit from card types like this. They prevent all of the power lying with the player currently taking their turn, and give some control to each player. So, 60+ patches later, we've finally added that control. Let's have some fun and get competitive ladies and gentleman![h1]Patch 1.4.3c[/h1][list] 	[*][h1]New Cards[/h1][list] 	[*][b]Celestial Storm[/b] - When Celestial Storm comes into play, all of your opponents unit's can not attack for that turn. Celestial Storm can be played at any time.[/*] 	[*][b]A Temporary Distraction[/b] - When A Temporary Distraction comes into play, return the last card played by your opponent back to their hand.[/*][/list][/*] 	[*][h1]Card Changes[/h1][list] 	[*][b]Cutting Costs [/b]- Description changed from "Discard two cards, in exchange, get one mana." to "Discard two cards, in exchange, get one mana. Cutting Costs can be played during your opponent's turn."[/*][/list][/*] 	[*][h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][list] 	[*]Commander Geod now properly spawns a card if there is space available on the board.[/*] 	[*]Tactical Nuke now properly kills everything on the board, and removes debuffs.[/*] 	[*]Fixed a bug where the game would freeze when you unlock a card.[/*][/list][/*] 	[*][h1]Backend Changes[/h1][list] 	[*]Player libraries are no longer hosted client side, and have been now completely redirected to the server. This means you will have lost all the cards you've unlocked. This was planned and was done to prepare for a proper balanced launch of the game.[/*][/list][/*] 	[*][h1]UI Changes[/h1][list] 	[*]Added tooltips to important UI elements so you can see what they represent.[/*] 	[*]Added a new profile tab where you can keep track of your current rank, rating, wins, and losses.[/*] 	[*]Added the tutorial to the Profile/News/Tutorial tab in the right of the main menu.[/*] 	[*]Added a green halo around cards that are playable during your opponent's turn.[/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.4.3b - Early Access Prep
notes.content:
With Launch Day right around the corner, we've put out some new bug fixes as well as a handful of quality of life improvements and balance changes. Enjoy!



[h1]Patch 1.4.3b[/h1]
[list]
 	[*]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
 	[*]Fycus Tinn, Armory, Materials Generator, Queen Mary, Grand Engineer Oleinas, and Ydos' Blessing now apply their buffs and debuffs properly(This means that newly placed cards will receive the buff immediately, rather then the next turn.)[/*]
 	[*]Angry Marine now receives his attack from total graveyard cards throughout the entirety of his turn, meaning cards sent to the graveyard during your turn will buff his attack.[/*]
 	[*]Desperate Scrapper's ability should now work as described.[/*]
 	[*]Tactical Nuke should now clear the board properly.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed High Priestess of Ydos not receiving any health from her devotion check.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed Shade of Ydosa not spawning a clone upon taking damage.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed Ydos spawning when the trio of cultists are in play.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]
[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
[list]
 	[*]Rough Rider cost changed from 3 to 4.[/*]
 	[*]Space Grave cost reduced from 7 to 4, type changed from Tech to Trap.[/*]
 	[*]Stargate ability changed from "Draw 4 cards instantly" to "While Stargate is in play, you draw an additional card at the start of your turn."[/*]
 	[*]Ydosa Cultist ability changed from "Every time Ydosa Cultist takes damage, increase it's health by 1." to "Every time Ydosa Cultist takes damage, heal it's owner for 1."[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]
[h1]Backend Changes[/h1]
[list]
 	[*]New player accounts will only start with 100 energy instead of 500. This is to prepare for the upcoming launch as well as the Founder's Edition benefits.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed an issue with multiplayer not applying the correct stats after a match.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]
[h1]UI Changes[/h1]
[list]
 	[*]End Turn and Timer font changed to reflect the overall style of the game.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed a clipping issue with the Opponent Profile UI.[/*]
 	[*]Updated the patch version to reflect 1.4.3b instead of 1.4.1 like it had been for the last several patches.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.4.3 - Ydos, The Old One
notes.content: Strange and mysterious things are happening in the Galaxy. New cults have drawn the attention of many a space traveler, as they promise untold riches and power.  Welcome to the age of Ydos, the Old One![h1]Patch 1.4.3[/h1][list] 	[*][h1]New Cards[/h1][list] 	[*][b]High Priestess of Ydos[/b] - When the High Priestess comes into play, her health is equal to your total devotion to Ydos, multiplied by two.[/*] 	[*][b]Shade of Ydosa [/b]- A devout worshipper of Ydos, the Shade of Ydosa clones itself upon taking damage.[/*] 	[*][b]Xoyor, Destroyer of Worlds [/b]- Xoyor damages the enemy ships health directly for 2 damage at the end of it's owners turn.[/*] 	[*][b]Ydos [/b]- Ydos always has the same attack as his health. Ydos' gains health everytime one of his worshippers does. His health on spawn is equal to the total amount of health gained. He will only spawn if all three cultists are on the board at the same time(Ydosa Cultist, High Priestess of Ydos, and Shade of Ydosa.)[/*][/list][/*] 	[*][h1]UI Updates[/h1][list] 	[*]A tutorial page has been added to both the Settings menu in the Main Menu, and the Pause Menu, so you can easily access information about the game while playing.[/*] 	[*]Debug Card Type removed from the game and the deck builder.[/*][/list][/*] 	[*][h1]Gameplay Updates[/h1][list] 	[*]When you go to play a card on the field, green markers will appear where the card can be placed.[/*] 	[*]Unlock Card chance reduced from 100% to 33% after playing a match.[/*] 	[*]Fine tuned the Unlock algorithm to reduce duplicates.[/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.4.3 - Ydos, The Old One
notes.content: Strange and mysterious things are happening in the Galaxy. New cults have drawn the attention of many a space traveler, as they promise untold riches and power.  Welcome to the age of Ydos, the Old One![h1]Patch 1.4.3[/h1][list] 	[*][h1]New Cards[/h1][list] 	[*][b]High Priestess of Ydos[/b] - When the High Priestess comes into play, her health is equal to your total devotion to Ydos, multiplied by two.[/*] 	[*][b]Shade of Ydosa [/b]- A devout worshipper of Ydos, the Shade of Ydosa clones itself upon taking damage.[/*] 	[*][b]Xoyor, Destroyer of Worlds [/b]- Xoyor damages the enemy ships health directly for 2 damage at the end of it's owners turn.[/*] 	[*][b]Ydos [/b]- Ydos always has the same attack as his health. Ydos' gains health everytime one of his worshippers does. His health on spawn is equal to the total amount of health gained. He will only spawn if all three cultists are on the board at the same time(Ydosa Cultist, High Priestess of Ydos, and Shade of Ydosa.)[/*][/list][/*] 	[*][h1]UI Updates[/h1][list] 	[*]A tutorial page has been added to both the Settings menu in the Main Menu, and the Pause Menu, so you can easily access information about the game while playing.[/*] 	[*]Debug Card Type removed from the game and the deck builder.[/*][/list][/*] 	[*][h1]Gameplay Updates[/h1][list] 	[*]When you go to play a card on the field, green markers will appear where the card can be placed.[/*] 	[*]Unlock Card chance reduced from 100% to 33% after playing a match.[/*] 	[*]Fine tuned the Unlock algorithm to reduce duplicates.[/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.4.2c - Systems Engineer
notes.content: It's been one hell of a day here at my house. I think i've been up for probably 24 hours now. All of this effort has gone to improving the game and adding some competitiveness to it. So here comes patch 1.4.2c![h1]Patch 1.4.2c[/h1][list] 	[*][h1]Balance Updates[/h1][list] 	[*]Mk5 Autoturret - Energy cost changed from 4 to 5.[/*] 	[*]Reaver - Energy cost changed from 5 to 6.[/*] 	[*]Micro Assault Drones - Energy cost changed from 2 to 3.[/*] 	[*]Trader Jack - Energy cost changed from 2 to 3.[/*][/list][/*] 	[*][h1]Card Updates[/h1][list] 	[*]Added Particle FX and Sound FX to a number of cards.[/*][/list][/*] 	[*][h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][list] 	[*]Tech Sergeant Tinker - Properly spawns Defender Turret if available space in the Defender slots.[/*] 	[*]Removed card name still showing up on the 3D card model.[/*][/list][/*] 	[*][h1]UI Updates[/h1][list] 	[*]Removed ugly borders around health, card, and turn tracking.[/*] 	[*]Added Rank and Rating to the player profile on the main menu.[/*] 	[*]Added Ranked Borders around player portraits in game(This is local only, so only you can see your ranked border currently.)[/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.4.2 - Post Hurricane Irma
notes.content: For those who did not know, I live in the great state of Florida, and we recently went through Irma. After the storm, I was assisting in helping clean up the state. Now that everything is back to normal, I can get back to work on Captivus. So without further ado, welcome Patch 1.4.2![h1]Patch 1.4.2[/h1][list] 	[*][h1]New Cards[/h1][list] 	[*][b]Tech Sergeant Tinker[/b] - Tech Sergeant Tinker spawns a 1/1 Defender Turret when he comes into play.[/*][/list][/*] 	[*][h1]New Features[/h1][list] 	[*]Profile Tracking backend including the tracking of wins, losses, draws, Energy(see below), and if the player is banned or not.[/*] 	[*]Energy Currency - Beginning with Patch 1.4.2, I have introduced something called Energy. Energy can be used to purchase a random card in the deck builder. You earn 20 energy from winning a game, 5 from losing, and 10 from drawing. If you unlock a duplicate card, you will be refunded 25 energy![/*][/list][/*] 	[*][h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][list] 	[*]Fixed the Fatal Error upon loading into the game or finding a match.[/*][/list][/*][/list]Players who play during the latest patch will find that they are unable to match with others in multiplayer and will get stuck in an endless loading loop. There is nothing I can do about this until Steam re-enables our Lobby system. It was disabled accidentally when we accidentally set the price to free-to-play.I would also like to announce that Early Access will not be free-to-play. I no longer have a job due to the storm, and I simply can not continue to develop this and provide for my family without some form of income. The price on release will be $5 and you will be given 500 energy as well as a few other rewards to start off with.

notes.title: Hurricane Irma Update
notes.content:
[h1]Hello fellow players,[/h1]
Recently, my home state of Florida was struck by Hurricane Irma. While I was very fortunate that none of my property was damaged, and I did not lose power, my actual job had required me to help and assist in cleaning up our area and assist the rest of the state. Now that we are back on schedule, I will continue to update Captivus at it's normal rate.

[h1]So what can you expect in the next coming months?[/h1]
In the next month, I have a new trailer planned, that will hopefully draw in new players with it's gameplay. 

I have a few founder packs ideas that I am bouncing around that will offer players the incentive to invest in the game for some neat cosmetic rewards in return.

20+ new cards will be released during September and October.

October 3rd will be the official Early Access release date!

Thank you for continuing to support me, and I hope to see you guys on the spacefield very soon!

notes.title: Patch 1.4.1 - Are we there yet?
notes.content: I can't believe we are already at the half way mark. If you've read the road map, the plan is to have 100 cards implemented by December 25th, 2017. It is now August 23rd, 2017, and we are half way there. Today's patch will introduce 3 new cards, as well as some sweeping changes and needed balance. Check out the notes below.[h1]Patch 1.4.1[/h1][list] 	[*][h1]New Cards[/h1][list] 	[*]Monument of Injustice - At the beginning of your turn, you gain one life, and the enemy loses one life.[/*] 	[*]The Grappler - The Grappler sinks his hooks into the enemy ship. At the start of your turn, the rest of your units can attack twice.[/*] 	[*]Captain Mal(Commander) - Captain Mal can attack enemy units, defenders, and turrets.[/*][/list][/*] 	[*][h1]Card Changes[/h1][list] 	[*]Grand Engineer Oleinas - Ability changed from "Reduces energy cost of cards in your hand by 1" to "Grand Engineer Oleinas is active for 5 turns. While he is active, he will give a +1/+1 buff to all units, defenders, and turrets at the beginning of each turn."[/*] 	[*]J-54 Defender - Damage changed from 2 to 1. Health changed from 4 to 3.[/*] 	[*]Micro Assault Drones - Ability changed from "Can attack both units and the enemy ship." to "The Micro Assault Drones can attack both ship and unit. It's health is the amount of drones currently in stock, and it's attack will always be equal to it's health."[/*] 	[*]Armory now correctly informs the player that the effect does not stack.[/*][/list][/*] 	[*][h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][list] 	[*]Plasma Torch should now damage the enemy.[/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.4.0 - Ready, Aim, Fire!
notes.content: Patch 1.4.0 is bringing a complete UI overhaul, new cards, and some updates to old cards! Let's get to work friends.[h1]Patch 1.4.0[/h1][list] 	[*][h1]New Cards[/h1][list] 	[*]Readiness - Readiness resets the interaction points of your units, allowing them to attack once more after they've already attacked.[/*] 	[*]Veteran Influence - Veteran Influence buffs the health of every friendly unit, turret, and defender currently on the board by 1.[/*] 	[*]Micro Assault Drones - This is a turret that can attack both player and unit.[/*][/list][/*] 	[*][h1]Card Updates[/h1][list] 	[*]B4-5T-10N Assault Bot[list] 	[*]Ability Update: B4-5T-10N's attack is always equal to his health.[/*] 	[*]Attack and Health changed from 5/8 to 4/4[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*] 	[*][h1]UI[/h1][list] 	[*]The UI has been completely updated. The main menu has received all new buttons, and the player frames have been updated in game to better suit the theme of the game.[/*][/list][/*] 	[*][h1]Card Unlocks[/h1][list] 	[*]Changed the chance of unlocking a card from 1/6 to 100%, with a 1/3 chance to unlock either 1 card, 2 cards, or 3 cards.[/*][/list][/*][/list]As you can see, it's been an exciting new patch. I hope to see you all in game soon and for you all to test out and enjoy this current patch.

notes.title: Patch 1.3.9 – A Mechanic’s Touch
notes.content: This patch has finally fixed some long standing bugs as well as fixed some that have been added with the latest patch.[h1]Patch 1.3.8[/h1][list] 	[*][h1]Deck Editor[/h1][list] 	[*]Fixed an issue where new unlocked cards could not be added to a new deck.[/*][/list][/*] 	[*][h1]Unlockable Cards[/h1][list] 	[*]The chance of unlocking a card has now been decreased, and instead you will have a 1/6 chance to either Unlock One Card, Unlock Two Cards, Unlock three cards, or Unlock no card.[/*][/list][/*] 	[*][h1]Card Changes and Fixes[/h1][list] 	[*]Fycus Tinn's buff effect now stacks with Armory and Materials Generator.[/*] 	[*]Armory's buff effect now stacks with Fycus Tinn and Materials Generator.[/*] 	[*]Materials Generator's buff effect now stacks with Fycus Tinn and Armory[/*] 	[*]Buff effects are unique to the card. Playing Armory x2 will not give you +2 attack on all units.[/*][/list][/*][/list]With all these fixes, I hope we can start to head in the direction of competitive play. Be sure to tune into the Dev Blog coming out this week.

notes.title: Patch 1.3.8 – Hard Work Required
notes.content:
Introducing: Unlockable Cards!

[list]
[*]Starting from this patch forward, the Card Library will only start with 10 cards unlocked. Playing games will give you a randomized chance to unlock a new card permanently to further expand your deck.
[/list]
I apologize for such a small patch, but it’s a huge step forward! Go out there and earn those cards!

notes.title: Patch 1.3.6 Hotfix
notes.content:
In this latest hotfix we have fixed the following issues:

Card Bugs:
 -Queen Mary should now correctly apply -1 attack to all enemy Attackers, Defenders, and Turrets.

Board Bugs:
 -You can no longer place infinite cards in Player 1's boarding party slots, or place cards on top of each other.

Multiplayer:
 -Peer-to-peer Matchmaking is finally working. Hit the find match button and begin playing today!
